title: Fight Song
content:
MASTERPIECE!

I'm very sensitive to handing over 10s out of 10s, for the sake of that, I'm gonna praise this work of art while holding immensely the generosity.

What do I start with? Right, the title, very uninspired, very bland, but that's part of the hook in my opinion, but who cares about that when you have a feast of a visual in front of you. As the 12th ending theme song of Chainsaw Man, this demonic, gory and violent work of art walks hand-in-hand with its parent show, along the same gruesome themes.

I highly recommend you give this a watch... or a listen.
